monthly earnings.description: Earnings breakdown across cash_point, referral_earning, topup, coupon_redeem for current month
select_expressions: SUM(CASE WHEN wallet_transaction.transaction_type = 'cash_point' THEN wallet_transaction.amount ELSE 0 END) AS cash_point_earning
SUM(CASE WHEN wallet_transaction.transaction_type = 'referral_earning' THEN wallet_transaction.amount ELSE 0 END) AS referral_earning
SUM(CASE WHEN wallet_transaction.transaction_type = 'topup' THEN wallet_transaction.amount ELSE 0 END) AS topup_earning
SUM(CASE WHEN wallet_transaction.transaction_type = 'coupon_redeem' THEN wallet_transaction.amount ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_redeem_earning

retailer earnings.condition: users.user_role = 2 AND wallet_transaction.transaction_type IN ('cash_point', 'referral_earning', 'topup', 'coupon_redeem') AND wallet_transaction.created_at >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01')
retailer earnings.description: Retailer earnings breakdown across cash_point, referral_earning, topup, coupon_redeem for current month
select_expressions: SUM(CASE WHEN wallet_transaction.transaction_type = 'cash_point' THEN wallet_transaction.amount ELSE 0 END) AS cash_point_earning
SUM(CASE WHEN wallet_transaction.transaction_type = 'referral_earning' THEN wallet_transaction.amount ELSE 0 END) AS referral_earning
SUM(CASE WHEN wallet_transaction.transaction_type = 'topup' THEN wallet_transaction.amount ELSE 0 END) AS topup_earning
SUM(CASE WHEN wallet_transaction.transaction_type = 'coupon_redeem' THEN wallet_transaction.amount ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_redeem_earning

redemption.description: Redemptions or redeemed amounts map strictly to wallet_transaction.reference_type = 'withdrawal'.

redeem.description: Redemptions or redeemed amounts map strictly to wallet_transaction.reference_type = 'withdrawal'.

earnings.description: Earnings map strictly to wallet_transaction.reference_type IN ('cash_point', 'topup', 'coupon_redeem').

earned.description: Earnings map strictly to wallet_transaction.reference_type IN ('cash_point', 'topup', 'coupon_redeem').

balance.description: Always calculate wallet balance dynamically by joining users and wallet_transaction on users.id = wallet_transaction.user_id and summing wt.amount grouped by user.

wallet balance.description: Always calculate wallet balance dynamically by joining users and wallet_transaction on users.id = wallet_transaction.user_id and summing wt.amount grouped by user.

sku_scanned_boxes.wholesaler_join: status_wholesaler_id = users.id AND wholesaler_scanned_at IS NOT NULL
sku_scanned_boxes.retailer_join: status_retailer_id = users.id AND retailer_scanned_at IS NOT NULL
sku_scanned_boxes.description: Calculates scanned boxes using `sku_code` join, mapping `uom` and `box_calculation_uom` across wholesaler and retailer scan timestamps.

scanned_boxes_retailer.condition: retailer_scanned_at IS NOT NULL AND status_retailer_id IS NOT NULL
scanned_boxes_retailer.description: Retailer box scans joining sku_inventories and sku_qr_points_map on sku_code.

scanned boxes retailer.condition: retailer_scanned_at IS NOT NULL AND status_retailer_id IS NOT NULL
scanned boxes retailer.description: Retailer box scans joining sku_inventories and sku_qr_points_map on sku_code.

retailer box scans.condition: retailer_scanned_at IS NOT NULL AND status_retailer_id IS NOT NULL
retailer box scans.description: Retailer box scans joining sku_inventories and sku_qr_points_map on sku_code.

scanned_boxes_wholesaler.condition: wholesaler_scanned_at IS NOT NULL AND status_wholeseller_id IS NOT NULL
scanned_boxes_wholesaler.description: Wholesaler box scans joining sku_inventories and sku_qr_points_map on sku_code.

scanned boxes wholesaler.condition: wholesaler_scanned_at IS NOT NULL AND status_wholeseller_id IS NOT NULL
scanned boxes wholesaler.description: Wholesaler box scans joining sku_inventories and sku_qr_points_map on sku_code.

wholesaler box scans.condition: wholesaler_scanned_at IS NOT NULL AND status_wholeseller_id IS NOT NULL
wholesaler box scans.description: Wholesaler box scans joining sku_inventories and sku_qr_points_map on sku_code.
